subject: THINK MARK
body:
THINK, MARK!

Sorry. Every new Viltrumite has to get that yelled at them once, its the law. J.K. Simmons said it like four times I should at least be able to say it once.

House rules from your step uncle Wade. If a guy with a big mustache flies you above the clouds to explain how you'll outlive everybody you love, that isnt a dad moment, its a fascist army recruitment. And if you ever look down at a town and catch yourself thinking "look what they need to mimic a fraction of our power", go touch grass.

-W
